notes.title: Broken Update Glitch
notes.notes:
[h1]Good day, fellow travelers![/h1]

The last update we made contained sexy voices and we were really proud, but we made a mistake and the game didn't open (oopsie!). But don't worry, it's all fixed now, so you can continue flying with your favorite anime crew!

If you already played the game before the voices, you can check it out again and relive your glory days amongst the clouds! 

Thanks for your support and patience! Arigatou gozaimasu!

notes.title: Update with voices!
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Kon'nichiwa[/h1][/b]

After some feedback, we decided to make a quick update adding voices to special scenes of the characters to add them more personality and to make a better impact on the experience. 
[b]Hope you enjoy it! [/b]
To know more about PA and our other projects follow us in social media as Kavorkaplay. :) 

[b]Arigatou Gozaimasu [/b]
